traits.leaf_arrangement.note: NZ Flora Epilobium (read 2026-10-17): leaves opposite at least below the inflorescence, the upper ones often alternate; sometimes alternate throughout and seldom whorled.

traits.inflorescence.note: NZ Flora Epilobium (read 2026-10-17): flowers single in the leaf axils, at times grouped into a more or less distinct terminal raceme-like inflorescence.
